exposure: Surgical training received by US general surgery residents
cohort: US general surgery residents graduating between 2009-2015
finding: US general surgical training does not align with the surgical caseload needs of humanitarian organizations like Médecins Sans Frontières, particularly in obstetrics/gynecology and orthopedics.
mod_finding: US surgical residents perform fewer cesarean sections and hysterectomies than are typically required in humanitarian settings.
